LESSON: SEASONS IN THE COUNTY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Natural and Built Environments
Topic 1.4: Seasons in the County
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Seasons in the County, part of Natural and Built Environments in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How do different seasons influence human activities in the county?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Seasons in the County together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: Learners carry out research/investigations in groups about seasons experienced in the County.

● Digital Literacy: Learners interact with digital resources with assistive technology to identify seasons experienced in the county

(Hot, cold, dry and rainy season).

Values:
• Respect: Learners brainstorm in groups about seasons experienced in the county as they understand, appreciate and respect other

learners' opinions.

• Unity: Learners strive to achieve a common goal as they observe and record in charts or braille cards, human activities associated

with different seasons.

• Patriotism: Learners sing songs about seasons experienced in the County.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety and security: Learners take safety precautions as they use print, braille resources or digital resources with assistive technology

to identify seasons experienced in the county (Hot, cold, dry and rainy season).

• Citizenship: Learners engage effectively with others and sing songs about seasons experienced in the County.

Links to other Learning Areas:
● Creative Arts as learners sing songs about seasons experienced in the County.

● Agriculture and nutrition: Learners explain how different seasons influence human activities in the County.

● Science and Technology as learners find out from parents or guardians how to conserve the main physical features in the county and

share.

Main points to remember:

2. explain how four seasons influence human activities in the county,
